'''Urinth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Inquisitor|Inquisitor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
She resided in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], and represented the Intelligence Operations of the Sith. Once she told an [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolyte]] that she had captured a [[Quorian Dorjis|Jedi]] trying to infiltrate the Academy. Through sorcery and drugs, she manipulated his mind so when he returned to the Order he would unknowingly feed false information to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. The information was supposed to lead some Outer Rim colonies to reduce their defenses, so the Sith could destroy them. To bring the information to the Republic, the acolyte had to gain the Jedi's trust and then secretly release him so he'd escape without questioning.
